observations: Photo 0: A single bed with a dark wood-grain frame and headboard. The mattress is covered with a grey and white patterned sheet.
Photo 1: A two-door wooden wardrobe with a brown wood-grain finish and vertical silver handles. One door is open, showing clothes hanging inside.
Photo 2: A black fabric 3-seater sofa. There are visible light-colored marks or stains on the right armrest.
All photos feature 'CROWN OLIVA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' watermarks.
The wall tiles in photos 0 and 1 are identical (cream with a diamond pattern), while photo 2 shows a different multi-colored brick-style tile pattern.
